# Getting Started

Welcome to the team. This page shows how to find your way around the handbook and what the coloured boxes on each page mean.

## Finding a page

There are three ways to find what you need:

1. **Browse** the folders on the left. *Guides* holds everyday tasks; *Technical* explains the systems behind them.
2. **Search** with the box at the top of the window. Search looks inside every page, including section headings.
3. **Follow links** inside a page. A link to another page in this handbook opens right here. A link to a website opens in your web browser.

## Reading tips

- Use the **On this page** list on the right to jump between sections.
- Open two pages side by side when you need to compare them, such as the [[Security]] guide and the [[Troubleshooting]] guide.
- Star the pages you use every day. They appear under *Favorites*.
- Bookmark a section you'll come back to, such as the printing price list.

## What the coloured boxes mean

> [!NOTE]
> A note adds useful background. You can skip it if you're in a hurry.

> [!TIP]
> A tip shows a quicker or easier way to do something.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Important information you need to complete a task correctly.

> [!WARNING]
> A warning means something could go wrong for a patron, such as losing unsaved work.

> [!CAUTION]
> Caution marks actions that can't be undone. Ask a supervisor first.

## Your first week

| Day | What to read | Time |
|---|---|---|
| Monday | [[Introduction]] | 10 minutes |
| Tuesday | [[Security]] | 15 minutes |
| Wednesday | [[Troubleshooting]] | 15 minutes |
| Thursday | [[Glossary]] | 5 minutes |
| Friday | Shadow a colleague at the desk | 2 hours |

When you've finished, you're ready to help patrons at the digital services desk.

## Getting help

Your first-week buddy is listed on the staff noticeboard. You can also ask anyone on the Digital Services Team.
